findings: DuplicateGroup permits an empty files array through its memberwise initializer; keeper indexes files even when empty. Nonempty group is an external invariant. wastedSize multiplies without overflow checking.

Duplicate group/member models contain URLs and size but no physical file identity or verified content snapshot. MoveOperation persistence records only original/destination path, without content identity or per-operation status.
ExtractedArchive model documentation describes full contents verified, although reviewed implementation checks path and size only. Do not treat its type name/comment as equality evidence.
Progress fractions clamp maximum to one but not minimum to zero; byte totals are estimates, and models contain no diagnostic completeness flag.

Managed marker checks accept any existing path at the marker name, without validating marker contents, file type or owner. Managed scan roots use profile folderName directly; profile validation remains to be reviewed.

DownloadsFolders silently turns directory enumeration failures into empty lists and does not deduplicate overlapping roots or files. Results are extension-filtered, hidden files excluded and locally sorted.
AppSupportPaths attempts legacy-directory migration and falls back to legacy on failure; directory creation errors are suppressed. No migration or user state modification was executed.
